description: Mirror Swap: after giving a recommendation, re-derive it from the user's own seat, using the user's own written decision model, and report only where the two passes diverge. Fires when the user asks you to decide as them. Trigger phrases include "mirror look", "mirror it", "as me", "review as me", "think as if you were me", "now decide it as me", "put yourself in my shoes", "what would you do if it were your call", and the compound form "review it, then review it again as if you were me, then bring me recommendations". Does NOT fire on "mirror" in the copy-content sense, on "write it in my voice", or on lookups and status questions.
